operation: Top N (Departure Airport x Landing Airport = route, N = 5)
question: Which five routes (departure airport to landing airport) bring in the most ticket revenue?
mdx:
-- Operation: Top N (Departure Airport x Landing Airport = route, N = 5)
-- Question: Which five routes (departure airport to landing airport) bring in the most ticket revenue?
-- Measure: Total Price
-- Answer key: mdx/answers/06_top_n_1.sql
-- TOPCOUNT over departure x landing airport tuples (routes); Rank = position in the TOPCOUNT result.
WITH SET [Top Routes] AS
  TOPCOUNT(NONEMPTY([Departure Airport].[Geography].[Airport].Members
                    * [Landing Airport].[Geography].[Airport].Members, [Measures].[Total Price]),
           5, [Measures].[Total Price])
MEMBER [Measures].[Value] AS [Measures].[Total Price]
MEMBER [Measures].[Rank] AS
  RANK(([Departure Airport].[Geography].CurrentMember, [Landing Airport].[Geography].CurrentMember), [Top Routes])
SELECT {[Measures].[Rank], [Measures].[Value]} ON COLUMNS,
  [Top Routes] ON ROWS
FROM [FlightCube]
answer_sql:
-- Operation: Top N (Departure Airport x Landing Airport = route, N = 5)
-- Question: Which five routes (departure airport to landing airport) bring in the most ticket revenue?
-- Measure: Total Price
WITH r AS (
    SELECT dep.AirportName + N' | ' + land.AirportName AS Member, SUM(f.Price) AS Value
    FROM dw.Fact_FlightSegment AS f
    JOIN dw.DimAirport AS dep ON dep.AirportKey = f.DepartureAirportKey
    JOIN dw.DimAirport AS land ON land.AirportKey = f.LandingAirportKey
    GROUP BY dep.AirportKey, dep.AirportName, land.AirportKey, land.AirportName
)
SELECT TOP (5) ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY Value DESC, Member) AS [Rank], Member, Value
FROM r
ORDER BY [Rank];
